notes.title: Speedrun Squad Update Notes 7/9/2021
notes.notes:
New update! This includes:


Overall smoothness increased
Improved art style and graphics
Slight adjustments to Menu GUI
Tweaks to level 3, level 9 and level 22
Various Bug Fixes


-Isaac

notes.title: Speedrun Squad Update August 16th 2019
notes.notes: This update adds a feature that allows you to see your world and individual level times after completing a world during a speedrun.

notes.title: Speedrun Squad Update August 9th 2019
notes.notes:
This update features a few changes that improve the overall gameplay experience.

 Fixed enemy hitboxes 
 Fixed slope jumping 
 Settings now remain the same after closing the game
 Fixed various glitches associated with the pause button
 Pause button now also works for ESC
